description: check-layers extension-boundary test (PR #799) asserted scan() findings in fixed array order; passed in the agent sandbox but failed on Linux CI because filesystem readdir order differs by platform. Walk-order is not deterministic across OSes — any multi-finding assertion over a directory walk must sort before comparing.
resolution: Repair run run_06ka61ctqz0j sorted findings (file,line) before asserting; commit 'test(check-layers): sort extension-boundary findings for walk-order determinism' on PR #799.

description: check-prose counts inline code spans stripped to 'CODE' as sentence starts, so backtick-heavy paragraphs get false long-paragraph violations
resolution: convert backtick-heavy explanatory paragraphs into bulleted lists, which are exempt from the >6-sentence paragraph rule
